Class EdgesBuilder.RouteMap

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.workflow.EdgesBuilder.RouteMap
Enclosing class:
EdgesBuilder
@Experimental public static final class EdgesBuilder.RouteMap extends Object
A routing map configured in EdgesBuilder.EdgeChain.route(Consumer) that maps each route the source node may emit to the nodes it leads to, written r.on("billing").then(billing). Mapping a route to several nodes fans out on that route.
